idea-plugin.name: SpringLens - Spring Boot RESTful API Tester
idea-plugin.description:
⚡ SpringLens — Native, Zero-Config Spring Boot RESTful API Tester

Stop context-switching. Test your Spring Boot APIs right where you write them.

SpringLens is a powerful, lightweight RESTful API testing client integrated directly into IntelliJ IDEA. Designed specifically for Spring Boot and Spring Cloud developers, it allows you to test, debug, and manage your APIs instantly without leaving your editor.

SpringLens automatically scans your project to organize all endpoints into an intuitive tree, generates mock JSON request bodies from your DTOs, effortlessly handles Spring Cloud Gateway routing, and provides one-click authentication sharing — delivering a complete, Postman-grade testing experience right where you code.

🚀 Why Choose SpringLens?

  • Zero Context Switching: Test endpoints directly within your IDE without opening heavy external applications.
  • Zero Configuration: No extra annotations, no YAML setup, and no dependencies to add to your pom.xml or build.gradle.
  • 100% Privacy & Offline: Your API payloads and auth tokens never leave your local environment.
  • Microservices First: Built from the ground up with Spring Cloud Gateway and multi-module architectures in mind.

✨ Key Features:

🔍 Deep AST/PSI Endpoint Scanner

  • Automatically discovers all Spring Controllers across all project modules.
  • Full support for @RestController, @Controller, @RequestMapping, @GetMapping, @PostMapping, @PutMapping, @DeleteMapping, and @PatchMapping.
  • Accurately parses @PathVariable (including regex patterns like {id:[0-9]+}), @RequestParam, @RequestHeader, @RequestBody, and @RequestPart (Multipart file uploads).

📦 Smart DTO-to-JSON Schema Generator

  • Instantly generates mock JSON request bodies directly from Java DTO classes, POJOs, and Records.
  • Built-in circular reference protection prevents infinite loops in complex object graphs.
  • Smart Merge: Preserves your customized input values when re-syncing newly added DTO fields.

🌐 Spring Cloud Gateway & Microservices Engine

  • Automatically detects Spring Cloud Gateway configurations from application.yml / application.properties.
  • Accurately computes reverse routing rules, including StripPrefix, PrefixPath, and RewritePath filters.
  • Seamlessly preserves individual downstream service context-path settings.
  • One-click toggle between Direct Service Mode and API Gateway Mode.

🔑 Global Authentication & Bearer Token Sharing

  • Full support for Bearer JWT, Basic Auth, and API Key (Header / Query param).
  • "Apply to All APIs" Button: Paste your JWT token once and instantly synchronize it across all scanned endpoints.

📁 Custom Endpoints & Collection Manager

  • Manually create custom folders and HTTP requests to test external APIs, third-party webhooks, or ad-hoc endpoints alongside your scanned project APIs.
  • Freely customize URL, method, headers, parameters, and payloads for custom requests.
  • One-click Copy as cURL command for terminal debugging and team sharing.

🔒 Dev-Friendly Local SSL

  • Built-in Trust-All SSL socket handler for local microservices running on self-signed https://localhost certificates without SSLHandshakeException failures.

💾 Workspace State Persistence

  • Automatically saves your parameters, custom headers, and request bodies per-project across IDE restarts.

🛠️ Supported Technologies:

• Spring Framework: 5.x, 6.x
• Spring Boot: 2.x, 3.x
• Spring Cloud: Spring Cloud Gateway, Eureka / Consul Discovery
• Build Tools: Maven, Gradle
• Languages: Java 17+, Kotlin

📖 Quick Start (3 Easy Steps):

  1. Open any Spring Boot project in IntelliJ IDEA.
  2. Click the SpringLens tab on the right sidebar.
  3. Select any endpoint from the scanned tree, review or customize the payload, and hit Send!

💬 Feedback & Issues: Found a bug or have a feature request? Please visit our GitHub Issues page.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — Initial Stable Release

  • Smart AST Endpoint Scanner: Automatically discovers all Spring Boot REST endpoints across all project modules.
  • DTO Schema Generator: Instant dummy JSON template generation from Java DTO classes with loop detection and smart merge.
  • Spring Cloud Gateway Support: Intelligent URL calculation for microservices routing with StripPrefix, PrefixPath, and context-path retention.
  • Authentication Manager: Bearer Token, Basic Auth, and API Key support with one-click "Apply to All APIs" global synchronization.
  • Postman-Style Native UI: Soft word wrapping, colorful HTTP method badges, response formatting, and cURL export.
  • Trust-All SSL for Dev: Seamless local HTTPS testing without SSLHandshakeException errors.
  • State Persistence: Automatically preserves parameter inputs and testing history across IDE restarts.
